diagnosis.B-14: The trace shows the card drawn after ≈ 0.5 s and the main thread idle afterwards (≈ 12 ms busy per second, one frame in 11 s). Chromium encodes canvas PNGs on the main thread only in idle periods; without frames there are none, and toBlob falls back to its fixed timeouts on Android (4 s start + 9 s completion ≈ 13 s).
diagnosis.B-13: Main thread mostly idle (one 55 ms task). The GPU thread is busy 982 ms of 1500 ms with raster tasks of 15–21 ms each; 36 dropped frames. At the tap the italic serif, the A05 room and the portrait start loading. Hiding single layers (animations, vector landscape, text halos, painted room, portrait; 2 runs each) did not remove the long frames. Ordinary tab switches to image-rich screens show the same first long frame.
